Janet Carroll Estate Agents is delighted to bring Apt 24 Brookfield to the market. This beautifully presented three-bedroom, top-floor apartment extends to approximately 71ms / 764sq.ft and offers a wonderful combination of space, comfort and convenience.

The apartment has been exceptionally well maintained and enhanced by its current owners, creating a stylish and welcoming home that is ready for immediate occupation. A particular feature is its dual-aspect orientation, which allows an abundance of natural light to flow throughout the apartment during the day.

Residents of Brookfield benefit from secure gated access, beautifully maintained communal areas and ample communal parking within this attractive and well-established development. Its excellent location, within easy walking distance of Ballsbridge, Donnybrook and Dublin city centre, makes this an ideal home for those seeking both tranquillity and accessibility.

The location of Apt 24 Brookfield is truly exceptional. Situated on the doorstep of Herbert Park in Ballsbridge, residents are surrounded by an outstanding selection of amenities, green spaces, sporting venues, restaurants and cafés.

Herbert Park, the RDS and the Aviva Stadium are all within easy walking distance, while the Bord Gáis Energy Theatre, numerous hotels, restaurants and local cafés are also close by. Mister Magpie coffee shop is just a short stroll away, while the home of Leinster Rugby is conveniently located across the road.

For those commuting to or enjoying Dublin city centre, Grafton Street, St. Stephen`s Green and Trinity College Dublin are all within walking distance, further enhancing the appeal of this superbly located property.

Combining an enviable Ballsbridge location with generous accommodation, excellent natural light and the convenience of top-floor living, Apt 24 Brookfield represents an excellent opportunity to acquire a superb home in one of Dublin`s most sought-after locations.

Viewing is highly recommended.

SPECIAL FEATURES
-3 bed top floor apartment approx. 71ms /764sq.ft
-Unrivalled location
-Sale includes all fitted carpets, curtains, blinds, light fittings and fitted kitchen appliances, 
-Gas Fired Central Heating 
-Spacious design with well-proportioned rooms
-Three double bedrooms 
-Owner occupied/investment opportunity. 
-Walk in condition.
-Mature highly sought after development. 
-Secure gated development with ample car parking spaces.
-Close to a host of amenities including tennis, rugby clubs, gyms, etc.
-Walking distance to the DART and numerous bus routes
-Short walk to the highly fashionable Ballsbridge and Donnybrook Villages
